Effect: This unit’s Memorian is a token. Add 3 to the control scores of friendly RUINATION CHAMBER units wholly within 12" of this unit while its Memorian is on the battlefield.
If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its Memorian from the battlefield after the Attack ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

entries.flavour: A Lord-Terminos's axe culls their enemies in great measure, but so too does it take the heads of fellow Stormcasts. These grim figures do not seek out the afflicted like merciless angels of death, however: these damaged souls come forth willingly, knowing that their time in the Mortal Realms has come to its inevitable end.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Stormcast Exemplar

entries.name: Lord-Veritant

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Staff of Abjuration
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilityDetails.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Gryph-crow is a token. Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units within 12" of this unit while its Gryph-crow is on the battlefield.
If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its Gryph-crow from the battlefield after the ATTACK ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

entries.flavour: The Lord-Veritants are chosen from those whose hatred of Chaos eclipses all else. They have the uncanny ability to detect the merest sliver of corruption: a skill that has seen many reassigned to the Ruination chambers, where their assistance in monitoring warriors after exposure to the most hellish environment has proved invaluable.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Stormcast Exemplar.

entries.name: Lord-Vigilant on Gryph-Stalker

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Deliver Judgement
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO RUINATION CHAMBER unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The Lord-Vigilants are the commanders and wardens of the Ruination chambers, who sequester their soul-stricken warriors away until the hour of the direst need. Much like their kin, their sense of self has begun to decay, but grim means allow them to maintain enough lucidity to command their brethren in battle.

entries.name: Lord-Vigilant on Morrgryph

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Direct The Assault
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO RUINATION CHAMBER unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 5 to the target’s control score.

abilityDetails.name: Vice-Like Grip
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has STRIKE-LAST.
• The target cannot use commands.

entries.flavour: A rare few Lord-Vigilants earn the trust and companionship of a Morrgryph, a creature sacred to the Bleak Raven. Their riders usually wield a long-hafted glaive for the reach it provides from their high saddle and its devastating power on the charge.

entries.name: Neave Blacktalon

abilityDetails.name: Justice From Azyr
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Whirlwind Axes for attacks that target a HERO.

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Windrider
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units and wholly within the combat range of a friendly THE BLACKTALONS unit that is not in combat.

entries.flavour: Neave Blacktalon is Sigmar’s foremost assassin. With the winds aetheric swirling at her feet, she can move with such speed that she appears to have teleported, sinking her axes into an enemy’s neck and darting away before they can react. Having beaten back the forces of Nurgle time and time again, Neave’s accolades across Aqshy and Ghyran have seen her ascend into legend.

entries.name: Neave’s Companions

abilityDetails.name: Shield of Azyr
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While any friendly THE BLACKTALONS HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: The first iteration of the Blacktalons was formed decades ago by Sigmar for the purpose of slaying an ancient god, though it eventually disbanded and passed into secrecy. Now it has been resurrected with Neave at its helm, with the intention that they will one day slay beings of a more ruinous kind.
entries.notes: This unit can only be taken in Neave Blacktalon’s regiment. This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
• Hendrick, the Silver Wolf, is armed with a Cyclone Sword and Axe.
• Rostus Oxenhammer is armed with a Stormcharged Warhammer.
• Shakana Goldenblade is armed with a Typhoon Crossbow, and her Star-eagle Anda is armed with Celestial Talons.

entries.name: Praetors

abilityDetails.name: Soul-bonded
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS HERO to be this unit’s soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve.

abilityDetails.name: Soul-forged Guardians
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: The Praetors are the bodyguards of the Stormcast Eternals’ commanders. Their souls are practically entwined with those of their designated ward, allowing them to absorb their master’s wounds into their own flesh through mere physical contact, selflessly enduring while their lord fights on.

entries.name: Prosecutors

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Heralds of Righteousness
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilityDetails.name: Dispersed Formation
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

entries.flavour: Many legends sing of the shining angels known as Prosecutors. However, long gone are the radiant winged heralds of yore. As the clouds churn with Chaos corruption, ever more Prosecutors have found their sense of self eroding, necessitating their reassignment to the Ruination chambers.

entries.name: Protectors

abilityDetails.name: Shield of the Storm
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While any friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HEROES are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: As a Protector retinue advances, they spin their stormstrike glaives in intricate arcs. By doing so, they create shields of celestial force, safeguarding their comrades while the Paladins eagerly put their warrior skills to work.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2025.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Protector Stormstrike Glaive.
• 2/5 models can replace their Protector Stormstrike Glaive with a Starsoul Mace.

entries.name: Questor Soulsworn

abilityDetails.name: Relictor Soulguide
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: You can pick a friendly Knight-Questor within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if you picked a target, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again within this unit’s combat range and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Ordained Quest
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.

abilityDetails.name: His Will Be Done
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:
• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: Stormcast Questors are typically solitary figures, carrying the burden of their divine missions alone, yet there are those labours so vital or challenging that even a Stormcast may not be able to complete them by themselves. In these instances, they are forged into gatherings of might known as Questor Soulsworn.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Reclusians

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Memorian Descendants
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Memorians are tokens. There are 2 Memorians for every 3 models in this unit. While any of this unit’s Memorians are on the battlefield, add 1 to this unit’s resistance rolls when using the ‘Ruination Chamber’ ability.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its Memorians from the battlefield after the ATTACK ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

entries.flavour: The Reclusians are warriors of the Ruination chambers, their identities eroded by countless Reforgings over centuries in service to God-King. Though they are close to becoming more engine of war than human, their lightning-scoured souls are particularly resistant to Chaos as a result, allowing them to tread where no other servant of Sigmar could hope to survive.

entries.name: Retributors

abilityDetails.name: Crushing Counter-blow
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is damaged or if any models in this unit were slain this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: A Retributor retinue wields crushing lightning hammers, amongst the most unsubtle and devastating weaponry in the Stormhosts’ arsenal. By channelling the storm’s fury through these fearsome weapons, the Retributors strike the foe with annihilating force.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2025.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Retributor Lightning Hammer.
• 2/5 models can replace their Retributor Lightning Hammer with a Starsoul Mace.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Iridan the Witness

abilityDetails.name: The Flames of Hope
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly RUINATION CHAMBER units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: On Wings of Death

abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below:
• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Demands of the Witness
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly RUINATION CHAMBER unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.

abilityDetails.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

entries.flavour: Able to endure the horrors of the Gnaw for far longer than their brethren, Iridan the Witness leads the Stormcasts of the Ruination chambers into battle with the resurgent Skaven in the easternmost Great Parch. Champion of the death god Morrda, they ride atop the Morrgryph Ariax and seek to reawaken their companions’ memories of past glories.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Stormstrike Palladors

abilityDetails.name: LIGHTNING QUICK
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

abilityDetails.name: SHOCK CAVALRY

abilityDetails.effect:

• This unit.
• A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.
Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly RUINATION CHAMBER units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 1" of the target.
• If the target charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The heart and soul of the Ruination chambers is Iridan the Witness, chosen champion of the mysterious death god Morrda. Dispatched to the battlefields of the Everspring Swathe, they lead a great detachment of silent, storm-eyed champions. Iridan rides the Morrgryph Ariax, a winged menace whose unearthly presence on the battlefield fills the enemies of Order with a bone-deep terror and robs them of their will to fight.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Sequitors

abilityDetails.name: Sequitor Aetheric Channelling
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect.
• This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

entries.flavour: Arcane mystery clings to the Sequitors, footsoldiers of the Sacrosanct chambers. By channelling celestial power through their wargear, they can bolster their strength to new heights, all the while carrying out the secretive missions of their hosts.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2025.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Sacrosanct Weapons.
• 2/5 models can replace their Sacrosanct Weapons with a Stormsmite Greatmace.

entries.name: Steelheart’s Champions

abilityDetails.name: Stalwart Defenders
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.

abilityDetails.name: Heroic Guard
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is in combat with any enemy units that charged in the same turn.

entries.flavour: The Liberator retinue known as Steelheart’s Champions embodies the resolute heroism of the Hammer of Sigmar. They have earned countless battle honours, and few foes cannot be overcome by the strength of their fellowship.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Heavens-wrought Weapon. The models in this unit are:
• Severin Steelheart (champion)
• Obryn the Bold
• Angharad Brightshield

entries.name: Stormcoven

abilityDetails.name: Gather the Aether
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.

abilityDetails.name: Aethershock
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Stormcovens are elite strike teams of arcane specialists who often find themselves operating as part of a larger Stormcast army. Each of a Stormcoven’s Knight-Arcanums has mastered a particular school of celestial sorcery, and when they combine their talents, the effects are truly devastating.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Stormdrake Guard

abilityDetails.name: Dispersed Formation
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilityDetails.name: Extremis Chamber
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

entries.flavour: The Stormdrake Guard are the result of the alliance between Azyr and the Draconith. In battle, they are holy terrors, the Stormcasts fighting with consummate skill while the drakes' burning breath and vicious claws annihilate their foes.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Draconic Flamestream, Draconith’s Fangs and Talons and 1 of the following options:
• Drakerider’s Lance
• Drakerider’s Warblade

entries.name: Stormdrake Guard (1 model)

abilityDetails.name: Dispersed Formation
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilityDetails.name: Extremis Chamber
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

entries.flavour: The Stormdrake Guard are the result of the alliance between Azyr and the Draconith. In battle, they are holy terrors, the Stormcasts fighting with consummate skill while the drakes' burning breath and vicious claws annihilate their foes.
entries.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each Knight-Draconis in your army.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Draconic Flamestream, Draconith’s Fangs and Talons and 1 of the following options:
• Drakerider’s Lance
• Drakerider’s Warblade

entries.name: Stormreach Portal

abilityDetails.name: Step Into The Storm
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER STORMCAST ETERNALS unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: A masterful example of Azyrite engineering, the Stormreach Portal adapts the mystical powers of the Star Bridges for use in the field. Stormcasts that enter its swirling interior can be instantly redeployed via lightning strike to an area within the Portal's vicinity, as if dispatched from Sigmaron itself.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable

entries.name: Stormsire’s Cursebreakers

abilityDetails.name: Overwhelming Storm
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control, pick a friendly non-HERO STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

abilityDetails.name: Averon Stormsire
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Averon Stormsire is on the battlefield, it has WIZARD (1).

entries.flavour: A specialist in the sundering of dark enchantments, Knight-Incantor Stormsire is also acutely aware of the negative toll Reforging takes on a Stormcast’s soul, relentlessly searching for any form of cure in even the most hostile of locations. The Evocators Ammis and Rastus have journeyed into many an unhallowed corner of the realms alongside their master and friend Averon Stormsire, wielding the crackling storm-magics of Azyr with a ferocious skill.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Cursebreaker Weapons. The models in this unit are:
• Averon Stormsire (champion)
• Ammis Dawnguard
• Rastus the Charmed

entries.name: Stormstrike Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Celestial Blaze
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.

abilityDetails.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Swift war-carriages of the Angelos conclaves, Stormstrike Chariots are potent linebreakers. As they build up speed, they draw the energies of Azyr to themselves before unleashing them in thunderous blasts amidst the enemy ranks.
entries.description:
This unit is armed with a Stormstrike Axe, Gryph-chargers’ Razor Beaks and 1 of the following options:
• Tempestuous Spear
• Great Stormbow

entries.name: Stormstrike Palladors

abilityDetails.name: Ride for Vengeance
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If any friendly WARRIOR CHAMBER units have been destroyed this battle:
• You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
• This unit has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.

entries.flavour: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.

entries.name: The Emberwatch

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Merciless Sentinels
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it contests an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

entries.flavour: The Emberwatch stalk the smoky darkness beneath Embergard, ensuring that its precious seams of realmstone do not fall into the wrong hands – be it avaricious Skaven, or ill-advised Sigmarites. Ardorn Flamerunner leads this band of Stormcast rangers, though his brash temperament often clashes with the cold and watchful knife-fighter, Farasa Twice-Risen. Yurik Velzaine styles himself as both the mediator and sharpshooter of the group, enchanted crossbow ever close to hand.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
The models in The Emberwatch are Ardorn Flamerunner, Farasa Twice-risen and Yurik Velzaine.
• Ardorn Flamerunner is the Champion.

entries.name: The Farstriders

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Star Falcon
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Sanson Farstrider is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Sanson Farstrider is one of the most experienced Hunter-Primes in the Hammers of Sigmar. He and his band of veteran rangers specialise in undertaking the most critical and death-defying of missions behind enemy lines.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with a Boltstorm Pistol and a Stormwrought Weapon. The models in this unit are:
• Sanson Farstrider (champion)
• Almeric Eagle-Eye
• Elias Swiftblade

entries.name: Tornus the Redeemed

abilityDetails.name: Herald of Redemption
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If a friendly RUINATION CHAMBER unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

abilityDetails.name: The Light of Sigmar
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Heal (D3) each friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS unit within this unit’s combat range

abilityDetails.name: Ruination Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

entries.flavour: Tornus the Redeemed is living proof that even the most tainted souls are not beyond salvation. A former devotee of the Plague God, he now serves Sigmar with an unshakeable faith. Reforged as a Knight-Azyros, he has dedicated himself to providing some degree of succour to the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers.

entries.name: Vandus Hammerhand

abilityDetails.name: Lord of the Hammerhands
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly WARRIOR CHAMBER units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Vengeance Unleashed
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: To Vandus’s warriors, he is still the same golden demigod as he was at the dawn of the Age of Sigmar. However, it is within this immortal shell that Vandus’s maddened soul is trapped, haunted by endless visions. As countless Reforgings slowly erode the last of his personhood, he dwells in his Stormhost’s Bleak Citadel between battles, watched closely by the Ruination chamber’s wardens.

entries.name: Vanguard-Hunters

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Star-marked
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while a HUNTED enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks that target a HUNTED enemy unit.

abilityDetails.name: Astral Compass
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
Effect: The target has the HUNTED keyword for the rest of the battle.

entries.flavour: Vanguard-Hunters are well suited for lifetimes spent in the wilds. Their short handaxes and weighted blades are as ideal for hacking through dense foliage as they are for carving apart flesh, while compact boltstorm pistols allow the Stormcasts to assail their prey even as they close in on them.

entries.name: Vanguard-Palladors with Shock Handaxes

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Shocking Strikes
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s Shock Handaxes, subtract 1 from wound rolls for that enemy unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The Vanguard-Palladors are the Stormcast Eternals' elite skirmish cavalry, able to ride the winds aetheric to strike with great swiftness and accuracy. Those among their number who wield the shock handaxe over the starstrike javelin are better equipped for sustained engagements and sudden charges designed to scatter isolated formations.

entries.name: Vanguard-Palladors with Starstrike Javelins

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Charging Volley
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: This unit can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target that enemy unit. This unit’s Starstrike Javelins have Shoot in Combat this phase.

entries.flavour: In addition to a boltstorm pistol, some Vanguard-Palladors are equipped with starstrike javelins, weapons that can not only be used in close combat but can also be hurled an impressive distance. Palladors so armed are highly flexible in battle, able to harry a foe's flank from afar or focus fire on enemy leaders caught out of position.

entries.name: Vanguard-Raptors with Hurricane Crossbows

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Coordinated Strike
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s Hurricane Crossbows to be the target.
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VANGUARD CHAMBER units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Vanguard-Raptors are natural hunters, often scouting ahead of the main battle line to harry the enemy with deadly crossbow fire. Those who favour the close-ranged kill form into retinues armed with hurricane crossbows, ferocious weapons capable of stalling the most determined enemy advance with blistering quick-fire volleys.

entries.name: Vanguard-Raptors with Longstrike Crossbows

abilityDetails.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Headshot
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit has not used a MOVE ability this turn and was not set up this turn, for the rest of the turn, this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability when picking targets for its shooting attacks.

entries.flavour: Raining death upon the enemy from afar, Vanguard-Raptors armed with longstrike crossbows are marksmen with few equals. They often seek to eliminate enemy leaders and champions, spreading panic and disorder through the foe's ranks with carefully chosen kills.

entries.name: Vanquishers

abilityDetails.name: Lightning Strikes
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Celestial Greatswords for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

entries.flavour: Vanquishers are greatsword-wielding infantry who specialise in carving through formations of numerous foes. The blade of each warrior is inset with a fragment of celestium, over which they will meditate before battle until their spirit is one with that of the sword. So attuned, these Stormcasts use the fragmentary visions provided by the realmstone shard to guide their strikes.

entries.name: Vigilors

abilityDetails.name: Navigators of the Storm
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If an enemy unit had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Clad in thunderstrike armour, Vigilors are skilled archers who fearlessly scout out a path for their brethren. Their arrows conjure brief flashes of lightning upon impact, sending coded signals to their kin and giving away the enemy’s position

entries.name: Vindictors

abilityDetails.name: Hold the Shieldwall
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Vindictors were amongst the first Stormcasts to be equipped with thunderstrike armour, their wargear designed by Grungni to defend against even the most aggressive enemy assaults. They are the shieldwall upon which the forces of ruin shatter. Forged from the most unrelenting souls, Vindictors will endure come what may and spit defiance until the last.

entries.name: Xandire’s Truthseekers

abilityDetails.name: Taros
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s Taros is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place Taros next to it.

abilityDetails.name: Harrying Aetherwing
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If any attacks made with this unit’s Stormcaller Bow scored a critical hit this phase, pick an enemy unit targeted by those attacks to be the target.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, place Taros next to the target. While Taros is placed next to an enemy unit, that enemy unit cannot use commands.

entries.flavour: Armed with the Lantern Astrala, Calthia Xandire leads her fellows in search of Harrowdeep’s forgotten secrets. With her comes Dhoraz Giant-fell, who revels in each destructive swing of his hammer; Luxa Stormrider, who lets her proficiency with the bow speak for her; and Luxa’s aetherwing companion, Taros.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
The models in this unit are:
• Calthia Xandire (champion, armed with Truthseeker Weapons)
• Dhoraz Giant-fell (armed with a Great Hammer)
• Luxa Stormrider (armed with Truthseeker Weapons and a Stormcaller Bow)

entries.name: Yndrasta, the Celestial Spear

abilityDetails.name: The Prime Huntress
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Thengavar for attacks that target MONSTERS.

abilityDetails.name: Dazzling Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: On Wings of Brilliance
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

entries.flavour: With the resplendent white pinions granted unto her, no beast is beyond Yndrasta’s reach. Her spear, Thengavar, relentlessly seeks out its prey when thrown. There are those in the courts of Azyr who observe the cold satisfaction Yndrasta takes in slaughter and whisper that lifetimes of battle have hollowed out her soul.
